correctness.rationale: The canonical cubic graph C5 square K2 has 10 vertices and 15 edges; M2 selects exactly edge subsets avoiding each of the ten degree-three full stars (equivalent to all selected degrees <=2). An independent complete 2^15-subset enumeration reproduced 10,895 faces including empty and f-vector (1,15,105,445,1245,2358,2985,2400,1100,230,11), dimensions -1..9. Independently applied the source's deterministic increasing-edge toggle matching: 5,447 augmented pairs leave one 7-edge face. Discarding the (empty,{edge0}) pair leaves exactly one critical vertex and one dimension-six simplex. A fresh directed Hasse graph checked all 64,005 incidences and a Kahn topological sort visited all 10,894 nonempty faces, ruling out gradient cycles. Forman's theorem yields one 0-cell plus one 6-cell with constant attaching map, hence integral homotopy S^6. No extrapolation to larger prisms.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Vega treats other bounded-matching families such as wheels, caterpillars and clawed graphs; Singh treats complete and complete bipartite higher matching complexes. No identified theorem with input family containing the cyclic cubic prism and prescribed degree cap2 supplies its S6. Prior same graph 1-matching is not broader by inclusion of faces; inclusion does not yield homotopy.
